title: Appraisal Order Report Age, Updates and Completion
content:
## Appraisal Order — report age, updates and completion

**In force.**
1. A report may support the note only while its age, in calendar days from the inspection date to the note date, is at most the report type's validity days.
2. A report type whose maximum age with an update is 0 cannot be updated.
3. Past the maximum age with an update, or where no update is possible, a new order is placed as a new order after expiration and charged in full.

**Retired.**
- "Between the validity days and the maximum age with an update, a Form 1004D update by the original appraiser keeps it usable and is charged the reinspection fee." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as retired text.
- "A value subject to completion or repairs also needs a Form 1004D completion inspection before funding, charged the reinspection fee." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as retired text.

### Age test — hypothetical cases (report type with 120 validity days and 365 days maximum with an update)

| Inspection date to note date | Clause 1 | Clauses 2 and 3 |
|---|---|---|
| 120 days | Supports the note | — |
| 121 days | Past validity | Not past the maximum age with an update, so clause 3 does not call for a new order |
| 366 days | Past validity | Past the maximum age with an update: a new order after expiration, charged in full |

For a report type whose maximum age with an update is 0, a report past its validity days cannot be updated and is replaced by a new order after expiration, charged in full.

superseded_clauses: Between validity_days and max_age_with_update_days a Form 1004D update by the original appraiser keeps it usable and is charged reinspection_fee
A value subject to completion or repairs (subject_to_completion true) also needs a Form 1004D completion inspection before funding, charged reinspection_fee.
